findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A).

Seven prepackaged individual bottles of Nesquick were observed with manufacturer’s use by dates of either September 2025 or February 2026. The PIC was shown and discarded the observed items to correct the violation. Ensure that the facility discards TCS products prior to their expiration date.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

The cooler noted in violation #22 appears to be holding at temperatures between 44F-50F per the inspector’s IR thermometer and the built in thermometer for the equipment. The cooler needs maintinance conducted. Inspector will Follow-Up in two weeks to ensure that the cooler is functioning correctly.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

TCS food in the cooler are observed with internal temperatures of 44F-50F. Foods include milk, hot dogs and cream cheese. Items were discarded during this inspection to correct the violation. This is a repeat situation from the previous routine inspection conducted on 12/6/21. TCS foods discarded during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Foods in the cooler labeled 10 observed to be out of temperature: gallons of milk at 48F, 14-16oz milks at 46F, and hot dogs at 45F. CORRECTED— All items in that section of the cooler were voluntarily discarded. PIC called cooler service provider while inspector was present to get cooler looked at and repaired.
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. [P]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment: Milk and other ready-to-eat foods stored below cartons of raw shell eggs. Store ready-to eat foods above raw to protect from cross-contamination. CORRECTED- PIC moved eggs to prevent cross contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11 (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from READY-TO-EAT FOOD. (P)

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed cooler 10 to be out of temperature. Infrared temperatures showed temps ranging from 50-55F. The cooler has been having issues, per the employee, and should be cooling back down to temperature now. The cooler was noticed out of temperature at 0900 this morning. The following items were discarded during the inspection: 4 gallons of whole milk, 1 gallon of 2% milk, 6x 1/2 gallons of 2% milk, 12 packs of hot dogs, 5 packages of butter, 2 packages of cheese, 3 packages of cream cheese, and 2 cartons of eggs.
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed the cooling unit within the facility to be at temperatures between 50-55F with PHFs stored in them. Ensure that if you are going to use PHFs within a cooler that it is maintained below 41F. 
750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
Observed excessive amounts of personal items stored on the shelves in the rear of the facility. Also, observed cigarette ash on an employee table in the rear of the facility. Ensure that personal items are segregated from service items. No smoking is allowed within a public facility. 
750-530c Employees may use tobacco in any form only in designated areas. Areas shall not be designated for that purpose if the use of tobacco might result in the contamination of food, equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed butane being stored on the top shelf, in the rear storage, above service items. Ensure that chemicals are stored below and away from service items.  
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Observed a spray bottle, that contained soap and water, to be stored in the facility without a label. Ensure that any bottles containing chemcials are properly labeled. 
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Outside storage area clean, enclosure properly constructed
findings.comment: Observed trash scattered across premise from the hole in the waste dumpster. PIC was notified and he made contact with Waste Management to get a new waste container. 750-1140 Garbage and refuse containers shall be in good repair and stored on or above concrete or asphalt.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
750-1170 All openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
The gap under the front door has not been repaired yet.
Repair the gap under the front door.
(The new door threshold is at the establishment, but the laborer to install this part will not available to install it until the week of 2/3-7/15.)
